evidence: Script /home/user/pt4/verify/d_8210/b1.js, same fresh copy. Iris (1366x768) spent 1 Intuition and rolled Survey rating 2 (3 dice: 4,3,3, Mixed success). Her tray offered BURN AND REROLL. With that burn open, the Lightkeeper desk at 1440x900 (out_8210/b1_lk_desk_open_burn.png, b1_lk_before_open_roll.png) shows only Iris's slip on the felt ('Survey +1d: 3 dice, highest counts, MIXED SUCCESS'), the roster cards and the log. The page text has no word for burn, resist, reroll or settle. The roster card has no marker, and the DICE / SECRET / ROLL 1 DIE controls carry no note. The Lightkeeper then pressed ROLL 1 DIE (open). Iris's Burn and reroll disappeared and her tray read 'Roll settled (i)' (b1_player_settled.png). The settling is the documented rule (FAQ.md:76, QUIRKS stale-burn-offer) and is not reported. What is confirmed is the gap: nothing on the Lightkeeper's desk tells her a player's burn is still open before her open roll ends it. This is not in issue #16, the decisions files, the calls kept as built, or issues.md. It is not a harness artifact: the check read the DOM, not timing.
root_cause: The server tracks the open roll in _last_roll (backend/vtt/ws/handlers/rolls.py:179-197, settle_rolls) but never tells the Lightkeeper. Her store keeps only tableRoll, the newest roll by someone else (frontend/src/store/gameStore.js:583-586, set at :1104). It has no open or settled state for other players' rolls. The open roll button at frontend/src/components/pc/dice/GmDiceControls.jsx:43-45 has no hint that an open roll settles the table.
fix: Client-only and small. Every open roll settles all the others, so at most one player roll can be open, and it is the Lightkeeper's tableRoll. Keep a tableRollOpen flag in gameStore: set it true when a player's dice_thrown arrives with a result below a full success and the roll not still waiting for its gilded die. Clear it on the Lightkeeper's own open roll, on End Assignment and on the next dice_thrown. In GmDiceControls, while the flag is set and Secret is off, show one short line under Roll, e.g. 'An open roll ends Iris's chance to burn on Survey.' (name and action from tableRoll), or add a small 'Burn open' mark on the felt slip. Optionally hide it when the member's sheet in memberSheets has no resistance left for that drive.

evidence: Fresh build on 8220. A player socket sent edit_sheet twice on Style, first Tidy to a long line, then the same line plus ', salt-stiffened cuffs from the ferry'. activity_lines row 9 (also visible in the player's log in screenshot out_main/sheet_after_use.png): 'Iris Vane: style Soot-grey coat, many pockets (key), a bi... to Soot-grey coat, many pockets (key), a bi....' Both halves are the same 40-char prefix, so the appended words never appear. The first edit also reads 'Tidy to Soot-grey coat, many pockets (key), a bi...', so the new text is cut too. Not a harness artifact and not decided: decisions_fix5 item 1 relies on the log naming what changed.
root_cause: backend/vtt/sheet_edits.py:42 SHOWN_MAX = 40 and :133-136 _shown(): text[:SHOWN_MAX].rstrip() + '...' is a prefix cut applied independently to the old and the new value; used by every free-text field and by _added_removed for gear and scars.
fix: For a free-text field change, compute the common prefix and suffix of old and new and show a window around the differing part (for example '...cuffs from the ferry' added, or 'style: ...many pockets (key), [+, salt-stiffened cuffs from the ferry]'). The simplest form is to raise SHOWN_MAX for free-text fields to the field max, or elide the shared prefix and keep the tail so the end is always visible. Keep the 40-char cut only for list items. Add a test with a change after char 40.

evidence: Reproduced the Lightkeeper side: Slink with Death Defy, LK dealt a Bleed mark, player sent resolve_ability_mark use; DB ability_uses = {"Death Defy": 1}. The Lightkeeper's open sheet (out_main/sheet_after_use.png, Role ability tab) shows only the Death Defy text, no spent state. But the finding's premise is wrong: the player's own dossier does not show 'Used this assignment' for Death Defy either (page text on the player desk after use has only the ability text and the log line). 'Used this assignment.' is rendered only by ScarAbilityUse (InvestigatorDossier.jsx:206-210, for Not Again and Forbidden Ritual, next to a Use button), and the LK's read-only sheet never renders that. So there is no player/Lightkeeper parity break; it is the same gap as F115 (no used or ready marker for offer-driven once-per-assignment abilities, both desks). The Lightkeeper not seeing a spent Death Defy is a real small gap, which the log covers.
root_cause: frontend/src/components/pc/InvestigatorDossier.jsx ability panel renders no used state from character.ability_uses for abilities without a Use button (Death Defy, soaks); ability_uses is already in the serialized sheet (backend/vtt/serializers.py:94) and so reaches the LK copy (GMCharacterSheet.jsx:358 renders the same InvestigatorDossier with readOnly).
fix: In the dossier's ability panel, for each once-per-assignment ability (ability_uses.py 'once') with ability_uses[name] >= 1 show a line 'Used this assignment.' (and optionally 'Ready' otherwise), for both the player and the readOnly copy. This also closes F115. Reclassify the finding as 'no used/ready marker on any desk', not an LK-only gap.

root_cause: backend/vtt/routers/circles.py:271-281 (finalize copies the players' chapter_house only 'if not circle.chapter_house_location'). backend/vtt/ws/handlers/gm.py:521-527 (handle_update_circle sets name, chapter_house_location and circle_ability with no is_finalized check). frontend/src/components/gm/CirclePage.jsx:390-406 (name and chapter house EditableLine) and :485 (ability select) have no is_finalized guard.
